draftInteractions.plan: Stand near the ally Irelia wants to reach and save Steadfast Presence for her dash into your area. Choose a supported countergank instead of chasing through her wave.
draftInteractions.response: Irelia can wait out the area or fight with ordinary attacks. Dash denial does not erase her stacked passive or guarantee an early duel.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep Steadfast Presence for a visible dash into your area during a gank. Leave a walking retreat instead of using every cooldown to push the lane.
draftInteractions.response: Lee Sin can change his approach or wait for the denial to end. This does not stop every form of movement or make an overextended lane safe.

draftInteractions.plan: Prepare Unraveled Earth across a likely dash approach when Lee Sin is visible. Keep your exit open and avoid spending all your control just to clear the wave.
draftInteractions.response: Lee Sin can approach from another angle or wait for the field to expire. A prepared zone does not replace river information.

draftInteractions.plan: Face Bullet Time with Unbreakable and position between the shots and your carry. The shield reduces incoming damage; Braum still needs health and a safe exit.
draftInteractions.response: Miss Fortune can wait for the shield or change her firing angle. Do not spend Unbreakable on minor poke just before an ultimate fight.

draftInteractions.plan: Place Black Shield on the intended arrow target before impact. Its control protection depends on the shield remaining intact.
draftInteractions.response: Ashe can threaten another target or coordinate magic damage to break the shield. A late shield does not undo control already applied.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep displacement ready for Samiraâ€™s close-range ultimate rather than using all your protection to poke. Stay within reach of the ally she wants to attack.
draftInteractions.response: Samira can wait for your defensive cooldowns or enter from a flank. Avoid being caught first, when you cannot provide the interruption.

draftInteractions.plan: Hold polymorph for a targetable Yi after he commits to your carry. Coordinate follow-up during the brief control window.
draftInteractions.response: Yi can wait out polymorph or use untargetability to complicate its timing. Spending Whimsy on an ally attack buff removes that defensive option.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep Steadfast Presence for a Rocket Jump that passes through your protection area. Position near the carry you intend to defend.
draftInteractions.response: Tristana can hold her jump or approach outside the zone. Dash denial is temporary and does not prevent her ordinary ranged attacks.

draftRules.advice: {targets} has early-pressure tools. Use defensive information and nearby lane support; do not assume you can contest every camp or river fight.

draftInteractions.plan: Keep the dash-stopping area available when covering a lane threatened by Irelia. Position around the teammate you can actually protect.
draftInteractions.response: Irelia can bait the cooldown or continue attacking without dashing. Check nearby allies before committing to the countergank.

draftInteractions.plan: Armor from Thunderclap supports a durable approach against repeated physical attacks. Build for the whole enemy team and arrive with allies who can follow your control.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx can keep her distance behind protection. Armor is not a substitute for reaching her, and other damage sources may require different defenses.

draftInteractions.plan: Defensive Ball Curl gives defenses and returns damage to attackers. Use that window with allied follow-up rather than rolling deep into a protected backline alone.
draftInteractions.response: Jinx can hold attacks, kite and let other teammates damage you. A defensive cooldown does not guarantee access to the carry.

draftInteractions.plan: Reserve enemy-targeted Frozen Tomb for Samira when she commits within reach. Its stun gives your team a control window during a close-range fight.
draftInteractions.response: Samira can wait for your ultimate or attack from another angle. Self-casting the ultimate uses the same resource and does not apply its targeted stun to her.

draftInteractions.plan: Stay beside your carry and reserve the dash-stopping area for Tristanaâ€™s committed jump. Check its availability before stepping forward.
draftInteractions.response: Tristana can attack without jumping or wait for the area to expire. This tool does not establish a winning Dragon-lane duo.

globalConditions.text: Judge both enemy laners together. Trade when your partner can follow, protect your health before a reset and avoid pushing blind.
Match your carry’s wave state. Contest space when they can trade; roam after a safe crash or recall rather than leaving them under a stacked wave.
Use wave priority to decide whether you can move first. Ping missing enemies and compare the cost of a roam with the wave you would lose.
Choose your route around nearby lane pressure and likely enemy movement. Take supported ganks; do not repeatedly abandon camps for low-probability plays.
Trade with the wave and your escape route in mind. Track the enemy jungler before extending, and do not spend all your health for a small farm lead.

wr.label: Wild Rift
wr.summary: Jhin gets earlier damage; Yunara and Senna lose damage. Cheaper Statikk Shiv and Yun Tal change purchase timings. Tank supports gain a cheaper, healthier Locket. Changes alone do not establish the best picks.

changes.Jhin: Higher standard critical damage; missing-health damage caps at level 10 instead of 15.
changes.Yunara: Lower first-ability damage; longer ultimate cooldown at later ranks.
changes.Senna: Lower critical damage, attack damage per soul and first-ability base damage.
changes.Volibear: More second-ability attack damage scaling and empowered healing.
changes.Tryndamere: Consistent critical chance per Fury and higher Spinning Slash damage.
changes.Hwei: Reduced passive damage, shielding and some spell damage/range.
changes.Nocturne: Lower health growth, reduced early first-ability damage and longer ultimate cooldown.
changes.Yasuo: Higher critical damage and stronger scaling shield.

strategyMeta.basis: Editorial kit and team-composition analysis. No rank-specific win rates, statistical counter claims or guaranteed builds. Role lists are conservative supported roles, not all possible off-meta choices.

meta.methodology: Every listed champion has editorial solo-queue guidance, counterplay and a cooldown/resource to track. Role plans and selected interactions explain opportunities, not measured counters. Scores reflect shown team composition, not win probabilities. PC kit references and game-specific patch summaries are separate from strategic inference. Named matchup coverage remains limited; unlisted matchups are unknown, not neutral. Legacy 7.1g rules are no longer used.

pc.label: League PC
pc.summary: Caitlyn and Jinx lose scaling power; Miss Fortune receives compensation buffs. Ranged Hubris and Gluttonous Greaves are nerfed. Includes the October 22 Varus hotfix. Summoner’s Rift only.

changes.Caitlyn: Less late-game Headshot damage; higher Q base damage at later ranks.
changes.Jinx: Lower starting health and attack damage growth.
changes.Miss Fortune: More E damage and stronger ultimate critical damage.
changes.Varus: October 22: Q multi-target bug fixed; passive scaling and minimum Q damage increased.
changes.Darius: Shorter Q cooldown at maximum rank.
changes.Lee Sin: Longer W cooldown and lower ultimate damage.
changes.Locke: Mana and sustain adjustments alongside stronger E scaling.
changes.Nidalee: Lower cougar W damage and E attack speed.
changes.Orianna: Higher Q and W ability power ratios.

draftChecklist: Choose the game first: champion availability, items, runes and balance differ.
Judge the full bot duo: range, engage, sustain, wave control and jungle pressure.
Plan your first purchase and power spike; avoid copying timings between games.
Check team damage mix, frontline and peel before locking a carry.
Prefer a practiced champion when matchup evidence is limited.

Reviewed duo synergies, first-item spikes and lane trading plans.
Per-role confidence and review dates; separate blind-pick safety from counterpick value.
